items.event_time_ist: Wednesday morning, Oct 14, 2026 (local Panhandle time, CT; Wednesday evening IST)
items.summary: Isaias power recovery in the Florida Panhandle: just over 20,000 customers were still without power Wednesday morning, Oct 14, mainly in Escambia and Santa Rosa counties, per PowerOutage.com data cited in the report. That is down from 45,000+ Tuesday and 149,000+ Monday; DeSantis says about 95% of customers who lost power have been restored, and the storm knocked out more than 400,000 Florida customers at landfall on Oct 9.
items.title: Isaias Florida recovery: just over 20,000 customers still without power Wednesday morning, mainly Escambia and Santa Rosa
